problem_evidence.interpretation: V62 incorrectly required one LeftBrain model call per case even though low-road rule plans are legitimate final cognitive plans. V63 measures one shared final plan per case and records its source without requiring every case to call a model.

causal_hypothesis: Given the same fresh input, isolated memory, psyche, route, shared final cognitive plan, Qwen3.5 9B model, prompt, generation settings, and scorer, attaching one runtime-built human_speech_plan before RightBrain payload construction will improve independent required-meaning recall by at least 20 percentage points without increasing forbidden meaning, private-memory leakage, duplicate replies, surface faults, or local resource use beyond the frozen limits.
causal_boundary: This pilot estimates only the effect of exposing the final cognitive plan to one-pass RightBrain surface generation. It does not estimate LeftBrain intelligence, memory learning, reflection, personality fidelity, unrestricted conversation naturalness, or broad human likeness.
experimental_unit: one fresh dialogue case with one frozen shared final cognitive plan

plan_source_policy.treatment_equivalence: Both sources must produce one nonempty runtime human_speech_plan before either RightBrain condition is evaluated.
plan_source_policy.analysis_role: plan_source is a descriptive stratification variable, not a treatment and not a fixed-count gate.
plan_source_policy.leftbrain_call_integrity: Observed LeftBrain model calls must equal the number of model_high_road cases; no exact preregistered numerical count is required.

c0_final_logic_without_speech_plan.description: Build the model payload from frozen final cognitive logic before human_speech_plan is attached.

t1_final_logic_with_speech_plan.description: Attach one runtime human_speech_plan to the same frozen final cognitive logic before payload construction.

fixed_variables: same final cognitive logic before treatment attachment
same user input, memory fixture, psyche, and route per paired case
same independent scoring-only required and forbidden propositions
one transport attempt and no model retry or repair call
stop_conditions: Stop before inference if the tree is dirty, a frozen hash drifts, freshness fails, or production memory isolation fails.
Stop before the first RightBrain call unless all 14 cases have one final cognitive plan, one valid plan_source, and one nonempty runtime human_speech_plan.
Stop if LeftBrain model-call accounting does not equal the observed model_high_road case count.
Stop the hypothesis if any automatic advance gate fails; do not expand the sample, request human ratings, or integrate runtime behavior.
Do not rerun consumed V63 cases, edit propositions, retry a model call, or change thresholds after inference.
If the speech plan fails, investigate a different semantic representation instead of adding case-specific prompt patches.

decision_rule.automatic_pass: Freeze the result and authorize only a separate new-data runtime integration shadow test.
decision_rule.automatic_fail: Freeze the negative result, keep production unchanged, and stop the full-speech-plan payload hypothesis.
decision_rule.production_change: Never authorized directly by this pilot.
